g.text: An arrow means "uses". Each part of src/ sits above the libraries it runs on; main.cpp starts all of them.
lib/: pure C++, unit tested on the PC

boot, Ethernet, loop() on core 0, setup1() / loop1() on core 1;
starts and runs every service above
files use the codecs in update_client
